name: MENT 3101
title: Managerial and Interpersonal Behavior
description: (Also offered as BADM 3740.) Topics covered include individual work motivation, interpersonal communications in organizations, team building and group processes, leadership, decision-making, and understanding and managing workplace diversity. Classes will emphasize interpersonal and leadership skill-building through the inclusion of exercises which rely on active participation of class members.
requirement_description: Open to business majors of sophomore or higher status.
